items.title: Hal Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: With Bob Haggart though, he lays down, he picks the time. So I’ve gone with him all weekend.

ctx.x: It’s going to work out fine. I have no question. The difference will be the piano, because Dave Frishberg was on the original recording that we’re supposed to be recreating. So of course he’s not here, and there’s no drums on the recording. So I’m going to be a real outlander there. But I’m not going to take charge of that rhythm section. I’m going to let those guys play as they would without a drummer, and just try and play lightly in the background. With Bob Haggart though, he lays down, he picks the time. So…
That acoustic guitar makes a big difference too.
